title: Kaylee Ricciardi Shows Diplo a $13M Malibu Mansion on Selling the OC
htmlContent:
Kaylee Ricciardi and global music producer Diplo were enjoying Malibu sunshine together, but it wasn't just another day of luxury real estate. On Netflix's hit series 'Selling the OC', Hollywood glamour and California coastal dreams collided in an unforgettable moment. This episode marked a turning point for Ricciardi, who showcased not only a stunning $13 million property but also her deep connections in the entertainment world. These connections could change her career trajectory forever.

Inside the $13 Million Malibu Estate

This 12,500-square-foot architectural masterpiece, situated on six acres of Malibu's exclusive coastline, features seven bedrooms and eleven bathrooms. The estate is designed for both luxury and longevity, featuring fireproof materials such as aluminum siding that mimics natural wood, as a nod to California's increasing wildfire concerns. As Ricciardi led Diplo throughout the expansive property, every corner showcased a new level of craftsmanship. The home exemplifies refined coastal elegance, with the 11-foot marble kitchen island serving as the focal point and the raised infinity pool offering panoramic views of vineyards and rocky outcroppings.
“It’s pretty amazing,” Ricciardi remarked during the tour. “You can host, create, relax, and even turn the ADU (Additional Dwelling Unit) into a private music studio — perfect for someone like Diplo.”

A DJ’s Dream: Malibu Meets Music

For Thomas Wesley Pentz, known as Diplo, it wasn't just about buying property; it was about creating an oasis of inspiration. Diplo's collaborations with Madonna, Beyoncé, and Justin Bieber have been widely recognized and have had an impact on modern pop and dance culture. Despite its global reach, Malibu provides something that money can't buy: tranquility and creativity. While exploring the property, Diplo thought about his lifestyle that was divided between Los Angeles, Las Vegas, and Jamaica. “Malibu and Vegas are my primary homes,” he shared. “But Jamaica is where I record and relax.” The Malibu estate strikes a perfect balance between a party palace and a creative sanctuary, thanks to its serene design and European-inspired pool. Sweeping vineyard views and secluded terraces allow one to imagine late-night sessions, quiet mornings, and inspiration echoing through its open-concept living spaces.

Kaylee Ricciardi’s Hollywood Rise on “Selling the OC”

This moment was a career-defining opportunity for Kaylee Ricciardi, not just a performance. The former dancer-turned-realtor has made waves on 'Selling the OC' with her charisma, confidence, and a knack for blending lifestyle and luxury.
“I met Diplo at Burning Man over a decade ago,” Ricciardi revealed during the episode. “I performed for Skrillex, and from there I just started hanging out with that crew. Diplo’s hilarious and one of the most genuine people I know.”
The personal connection paid off in a big way. She was given a rare opportunity to work with one of music's biggest names, which also helped her establish herself as a serious player in the luxury real estate market. “Of course, it’ll be huge to sell Diplo a house,” she said excitedly. “I’d be more in the running for Jason’s property — it’s a big deal.” The luxury market's success depends on relationships and trust, as much as property listings, as her natural ease with high-profile clients like Diplo underscores.

The House That Has It All: Innovation, Design, and Sustainability

Malibu real estate has long been synonymous with glamour, but this property stands out for its unique blend of modern innovation and environmental consciousness.

  • Fireproof Construction: Engineered with non-flammable materials disguised as wood, the house is designed to withstand California’s unpredictable fire seasons.

  • Smart Home Technology: Every inch of the estate is connected through a cutting-edge home automation system controlling security, lighting, temperature, and even music.

  • Entertainment Ready: From its pickleball court to the raised infinity pool, the home is a playground for celebrities and creatives alike.

  • Gourmet Kitchen: The massive open kitchen flows seamlessly into the living and dining areas, designed for both intimate gatherings and lavish dinner parties.

“Every feature here feels intentional,” Ricciardi said, highlighting the home’s versatility. “It’s as much about sustainability and safety as it is about style and comfort.”

Diplo’s Expanding Real Estate and Lifestyle Empire

Diplo's diverse artistry is reflected in his growing real estate portfolio, which is not only successful in the music industry but also in the real estate sector. He was recently featured on the cover of Architectural Digest, sharing his passion for architecture, interior design, and living spaces that foster creativity. In Port Antonio, his Jamaican retreat serves as both a recording space and a spiritual retreat. “It’s my place to unwind, to think, to make music,” he shared. The Malibu property is a perfect blend of art, nature, and rhythm, thanks to its ADU convertible studio and stunning vineyard views.

From Burning Man to Beverly Hills: Kaylee Ricciardi’s Journey

Ricciardi's story holds as much interest as the homes she sells. She epitomizes the modern LA success story: creative, resilient, and unapologetically bold. Fans and colleagues have admired her for her ability to navigate high-stakes environments — both on and off-screen. “I’ve come a long way from raving,” she laughed during the show, “but you can still rave and sell houses.” With her striking charisma, Ricciardi continues to redefine what it means to be a realtor in today’s celebrity-driven marketplace. Her approach is more than just sales; it's about creating experiences that connect lifestyle, art, and ambition.

Why This “Selling the OC” Episode Resonates

This 'Selling the OC' episode is more than just a luxury listing; it offers insight into the culture of Los Angeles. Music, real estate, and the art of connecting are bridged by it. The city's essence, where creativity meets opportunity, is captured by watching Diplo and Kaylee walk through one of Malibu's most breathtaking homes.

It's a moment that transforms a reality show into a cultural event for viewers, thanks to its blend of aspiration and authenticity. For Kaylee Ricciardi, it’s a clear statement that she’s ready to take her place among the top realtors in the industry.

Final Thoughts: The Future of Luxury Real Estate in Malibu

The Malibu market remains one of the most coveted in the world, thanks to its innovation, exclusivity, and sustainability. The future of luxury living is represented by homes like those showcased by Ricciardi and Diplo, which are bold, resilient, and deeply personal, as climate concerns shape modern architecture. For agents like Kaylee Ricciardi, these moments are not just professional victories — they are a demonstration of the power of relationships, vision, and authenticity. As 'Selling the OC' continues to capture the drama and glamour of high-end real estate, it's clear that Ricciardi is becoming one of its most compelling stars.
excerpt: Kaylee Ricciardi takes global music producer Diplo on an exclusive tour of a breathtaking $13 million Malibu mansion on Selling the OC, offering a rare look inside one of the city’s most luxurious coastal estates while highlighting her growing influence in celebrity real estate.
